description: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. was founded in 1843 by Frederick T. Stanley and incorporated in Connecticut in 1852, and in March 2010 completed a merger with The Black & Decker Corporation, a company founded by S. Duncan Black and Alonzo G. Decker and incorporated in Maryland in 1910, at which time it changed its name from The Stanley Works to Stanley Black & Decker, Inc., with its principal executive office at 1000 Stanley Drive, New Britain, Connecticut. The Company is a global provider of hand tools, power tools, outdoor products and related accessories, as well as a leading provider of engineered fastening solutions, with 2025 consolidated annual revenues of $15.1 billion, and approximately 62 percent of its 2025 revenues were generated in the United States, with the remainder largely from Europe (16 percent), emerging markets (13 percent) and Canada (4 percent).
